args.title: Summary: Retail Returns & Companion Piece (2026)
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making reverse logistics a major cost driver for retailers.
- Consolidating returns processing into dedicated hubs cut handling costs by roughly 20%.
- The companion piece notes that reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of their original margin, reinforcing the value of fast, centralized return handling.
